screening_decisions.reason: Randomised multicentre trial; women with stage I endometrial carcinoma received adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) after surgery vs control/RT strata—meets RCT and postoperative progestagen criteria.
Narrative review of progestin therapy across cancers; not a randomised controlled trial of postoperative therapy.
Methodological paper on meta-analysis inconsistency; not a clinical RCT.
Statistical methods for meta-analysis; not an RCT in endometrial cancer.

Meta-analysis methodology paper; not a primary RCT.

Randomised trial in endometrial carcinoma with progestogens as part of primary treatment in conjunction with surgery and radiotherapy; surgery is performed but timing of progestogen relative to surgery is not fully clear in the abstract. Conservatively include at title/abstract stage.
